name: sample_nodes
description: Return up to 5 real nodes of one label, optionally filtered and limited to some properties. Call it before relying on a property you have not seen yet - to confirm its exact name, type and shape (e.g. a list, or a JSON-stored record), or to see what typical values look like. Do not use it to compute figures; use run_query for that.

label.description: A label of the bank graph (see the data dictionary), e.g. Holding.

filter.description: Optional: property to value (equality), or to a list of values, e.g. {"clientId": "CL-0001"}.

properties.description: Optional properties to return (all when omitted).
